basic_info.description: Improved Price! This gorgeous 2 bed/2 bath unit is a steal at $947/SF! The lowest price/sf in the building. One Rincon is highly sought after by homeowners and renters alike. This SW corner unit is filled with natural light from the floor to ceiling triple-paned windows and has incredible views of the bay and twinkling city lights. The kitchen showcases granite countertops, Italian cabinetry, Bosch/Sub-Zero/LG appliances and plenty of storage. New in-unit washer/dryer. The gracious primary suite boasts two closets w/custom organizers, en-suite bath w/double vanity, glass enclosed shower and soaking tub. Guests won't want to leave the roomy guest room and their own full bath. Additional upgrades include custom light fixtures, blackout draperies, blackout shades, Phillips Hue Lighting and custom closet organizers. Are you ready for luxury? Amenities are bountiful at One Rincon: 24/7 front desk attendant, 2 fitness centers, separate locker rooms w/steam rooms, heated lap pool, outdoor spa, entertaining space w/2 BBQ's & fireplace, dog relief area, club house, business center, conference room and sky lounge. Convenient access to highways and short stroll to the Financial District and Embarcadero. This unit comes with one valet parking space and storage unit. What are you waiting for?
